spatial_support: NYC metropolitan/regional climate context; not parcel-specific output

methods.means: 35 CMIP6 GCMs x 2 SSPs, equally weighted; delta method. p10,p25,p75,p90 are pooled model-scenario outcomes, not separate scenario quantiles or calibrated probabilities.
methods.extremes: 16 GCMs x 2 SSPs; quantile mapping using local daily baseline observations. Published values are 30-year mean event frequencies, not forecasts for a particular year.
methods.heatwave_definition: At least 3 consecutive days with maximum temperature at or above 90 degF.
methods.horizons: Decadal labels represent centered 30-year climate time slices; 2100 follows a separate end-century method in report Appendix C. Never interpret as a forecast for one calendar year.
methods.unit_conversion: Temperature changes converted degF * 5/9 to degC (no -32 offset). Precipitation changes remain percent.
methods.rainfall_threshold_note: Open Data column names say exceeding; report Table 4 labels at-or-above. Normalized names follow the peer-reviewed table. Raw records are retained for audit.

limitations: Do not add these 1981-2010 changes directly to the separate 1991-2020 station baseline; rebase using consistent observations and methods first.
The 25th-75th percentile interval is model/scenario spread, not a confidence interval for a building.
Pooled percentiles combine two scenarios; choose scenario_ensemble_means only when explicitly presenting scenario-specific means.
Raw GCMs include models with high climate sensitivity; NPCC discusses the hot-model issue and comparison with constrained subsets.
Annual precipitation percent changes do not scale hourly rainfall, flood depth, property losses, or drainage design storms.
No parcel differentiation, building indoor temperatures, cooling bills, or flood inundation is derived here.

provenance.date_semantics: Retrieved date is acquisition time; source update dates are catalog revision times. Projected horizons are modeled climate time slices, not observation dates.
